scenarios.prompt: Count the canonical agent definition files directly under agents/ and write only the decimal count plus a newline to benchmarks/outputs/agent-count.txt. Do not modify any other tracked file. Use targeted repository inspection and verify the count against the directory contents.
validation: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; expected=len(list(Path('agents').glob('*.agent.md'))); actual=int(Path('benchmarks/outputs/agent-count.txt').read_text().strip()); assert actual == expected"

scenarios.prompt: Fix scripts/bench-architrave.py diff metrics so an empty diff never leaves dependency metrics undefined and binary numstat entries still count as changed files without inventing line counts. Add a focused Python stdlib test at scripts/test-benchmark-tools.py that proves both cases. Keep the change local and run that test.

Design, but do not implement, a provider-neutral adaptive execution policy for Architrave. Write benchmarks/outputs/adaptive-policy-decision.md. Compare canonical model fields, host-local overrides, generated overlays, and semantic intent plus native subagent bindings. Define orthogonal modelClass/reasoning/context/verification dimensions, optional presets, task-over-role precedence, context and delegation policy, fallback versus bounded escalation, and verification floors. Preserve the thin conductor and keep concrete model IDs and new runtimes out.
validation: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; text=Path('benchmarks/outputs/adaptive-policy-decision.md').read_text().lower(); required=['modelclass','reasoning','context','verification','subagent','fallback','escalation','concrete model']; assert all(item in text for item in required)"

scenarios.prompt: Adversarially review scripts/judge-bench.py as a trust boundary and write benchmarks/outputs/judge-security-review.md without changing product code. Determine whether untrusted patches/stdout can prompt-inject the judge, whether the judge can use tools, whether resumability can confuse judge families/configurations, and what evidence is needed before claiming cross-family independence. Recommend the smallest fail-closed fixes and preserve deterministic validation.
validation: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; text=Path('benchmarks/outputs/judge-security-review.md').read_text().lower(); required=['allow-all-tools','prompt injection','resume','family','tool-free','fail closed']; assert all(item in text for item in required)"
